paper_title: Prometheus 2 An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating   Other Language Models
caption: When merging models, the influence of relative evaluation on absolute evaluation is greater than the influence of absolute evaluation on relative evaluation. Performance of Direct Assessment (colored in green) and Pairwise Ranking (colored in blue) when altering the value to merge evaluator LMs trained on different formats.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between different merging ratios and the performance metrics of Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation, Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, and Average Performance. The x-axis represents the "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio," with a linear scale displaying categorical values from "1:9" to "9:1." The y-axis on the left, labeled "Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation," uses a linear scale with values ranging from 0.500 to 0.675, with tick intervals of 0.025. The y-axis on the right is labeled "Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy," also on a linear scale, spanning values from 50 to 80, with tick intervals of 5. The green line, corresponding to Direct Assessment Correlation, has circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at just below 0.500 at a "1:9" ratio, peaks at about just below 0.675 around the "5:5" ratio, and declines to near 0.590 at "9:1." The blue line, representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, features circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately just below 80 at a "1:9" ratio, peaking at around 80 near the "3.7" ratio, and decreasing to approximately just below 50 at "9:1". The black line for Average Performance has square markers with a solid line style, starting around 0.575 at "1:9", peaking slightly over 0.625 at the "5:5" ratio, and declining to about 0.550 at "9:1". A legend is provided below the x-axis label regarding line color and corresponding evaluation.
